summary: A warm, photo-led food delivery app for Berlin's local neighbourhood restaurants, from browsing and building a basket to live courier tracking.

screens.name: Welcome to Kiezbite
screens.spec: Three swipeable slides, each with a large appetising photo and a short title: 'Your Kiez, delivered', 'Local kitchens, not chains' and 'Track every bite live'. The page dots and a primary 'Set delivery address' button lead into home, with a 'Skip' link at top right.

screens.name: Home
screens.spec: The top shows the delivery address pill (Oderberger Str. 21) with a chevron, then a search field 'Restaurants, dishes, cuisines'. Below are horizontal cuisine chips with emoji (Pizza, Burgers, Asian, Vegan, Dessert, Drinks), then a full-width gradient promo banner '€5 off your first 3 orders – code BERLIN5'. The main section is 'Popular near you': large restaurant cards with big food photos, a heart, name, cuisine, ★ rating, delivery time and fee. Each card opens restaurant.

screens.name: Basket
screens.spec: The header shows 'Pizzeria Ruffiano' with the delivery address and an ETA of 25 min. Below are item rows with a photo, name, chosen options, a quantity stepper and the price, then a promo code row with BERLIN5 applied (−€5.00). A fee breakdown lists subtotal, delivery, service fee and discount, with a bold total of €39.78. The primary 'Checkout · €39.78' button opens order-tracking.

screens.name: Orders
screens.spec: At the top is an 'Active' card for order #RB-4821 from Pizzeria Ruffiano with a live progress bar and 'Arriving 19:42', which opens order-tracking. Below is 'Past orders': rows with the restaurant photo, name, date, item count, total and a 'Reorder' pill. Tapping a past restaurant opens restaurant.

screens.name: Profile
screens.spec: The header has Lena's avatar and name, then a gradient stats card (34 orders, €62 saved, Kiez Gold member). The sections are Saved addresses (Home, Work), Payment (Visa •• 4417, PayPal), Favourite restaurants as photo chips that open restaurant, Promo codes, Notifications, Help and Log out. Orders count links to orders.

screens.name: Pizzeria Ruffiano
screens.spec: The hero is a full-bleed cover photo with back and heart buttons, then the restaurant name, ★ 4.8 (1.2k), cuisine and an info strip for delivery 20–30 min, €1.99 fee and €12 minimum. A sticky segmented row of menu sections (Popular, Pizza, Antipasti, Dolci, Drinks) leads into dish rows with a thumbnail photo, name, short description, price and a round + add button. Tapping a dish opens dish. A floating 'View basket · 5 items · €41.80' bar opens basket.

screens.name: Pizza Diavola
screens.spec: A large photo of the dish fills the top half, followed by its name, description and base price €12.90. Below are a required 'Size' radio group (Medium 30cm, Large 34cm +€2.50) and an optional 'Extras' checkbox list (Burrata +€3.00, Extra 'nduja +€1.80, Basil oil +€0.80). The footer has a quantity stepper and the primary 'Add to basket · €18.40' button, which returns to restaurant.

screens.name: Order on its way
screens.spec: The top half is a map with the courier's bike pin, the restaurant and home pins, and a route line, topped by a big 'Arriving 19:42 · 12 min' figure. A vertical step tracker runs from Order accepted through Preparing, Picked up and On the way to Delivered, with the current step highlighted. A courier card shows Malik's photo, rating and bike, with a green call button and a message button. Below is a collapsible order summary (#RB-4821, 5 items, €39.78).
